scene: Aromatic steam swirls through the cosy, lantern-lit cabin of the tea barge.
picture: Side-scrolling view inside the warm barge cabin on a wooden floor line. Far left sits a bubbling copper kettle over a stove. Left of centre, a calico cat snoozes on a cushion. Centre stands the broad Pacific Islander man in floral shirt with his ukulele. Far right sits a bamboo ladder leading up to a roof hatch.
shown: a bubbling copper kettle resting on a clay stove on the far left
a calico cat sleeping curled on a woven cushion left of centre
a bamboo ladder standing upright against the open hatchway on the far right
